description.value: Chateau Big White is a hotel offering studios and suites slope-side at Big White Ski Resort, located in BC's Okanagan highlands southeast of Kelowna. The resort operates year-round, with a ski season in winter and a summer season featuring eBike tours, fat biking trails, and mountain activities. Guests are within walking distance of on-mountain restaurants, a market, and the full range of resort services.
